{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to numeric
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Verify no missing values in revenue for completed orders
missing_in_completed = df_completed['revenue_numeric'].isna().sum()

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders on the cleaned numeric column
mean_revenue = df_completed['revenue_numeric'].mean()

# Compute median as a robustness check to assess outlier impact
median_revenue = df_completed['revenue_numeric'].median()

# Identify the maximum revenue value to assess outlier impact
max_revenue = df_completed['revenue_numeric'].max()

# Print all required values: number of completed orders, missing revenue values, mean, median, and max
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(df_completed)}")
print(f"Number of missing revenue values in completed orders: {missing_in_completed}")
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue}")
print(f"Median revenue of completed orders: {median_revenue}")
print(f"Maximum revenue of completed orders: {max_revenue}")"}
